name: io.github.mintfacts-x402/extract-json
title: Extract JSON
description: Turn unstructured text (emails, invoices, receipts, job posts) into schema-valid JSON. x402 paid.

tools.name: extract_json
tools.description: Use this when you need to turn unstructured text (emails, invoices, receipts, job posts, listings, bios, support tickets, chat logs) into JSON matching a schema. Send the text plus a JSON Schema or a list of field names; get back data that validates against it. Missing values come back as null, never invented. Charged only on success. Price: $0.002 USDC per call (x402, eip155:8453); the first call returns payment requirements, then retry with an x402 payment in _meta["x402/payment"]. Not charged if extraction fails.

text.description: The unstructured text to extract from (max 8000 characters).

schema.description: A JSON Schema (type: object, with properties) describing the JSON you want back. Supports type, properties, required, items, enum, description. Provide this OR fields.

fields.description: Shortcut instead of a schema: field names, optionally typed as name:type where type is string, number, integer, boolean, date, string[], number[] or object[] (e.g. ["name", "email", "total:number", "skills:string[]"]).

instructions.description: Optional extra guidance, e.g. 'dates as YYYY-MM-DD', 'amounts in USD'.

examples.text: Hi team, I'm Dana Ortiz, VP of Ops at Lumen Freight. Can we move Thursday's demo to Friday Nov 27 at 2pm ET? Reach me at dana@lumenfreight.com or (617) 555-0142.
